author: thatdudealec
title: Starting to Hate This Game
content:
I don’t expect a game to be free because developers take time to build it and businesses have to make money, but this game forces you to constantly spend major money if you want to move forward in the game. As others have mentioned, the timers aren’t long enough for some levels so you have rely on the extra features which cost if you don’t have them. The main issue I have with this game is I’ve spent $9.99 multiple times for 6000 coins and a measly one hour unlimited life timer. The 6000 coins go fast as for instance, the UFOs cost 1400 points. What is causing me to uninstall the game as it cheated me out of coins. The timer was running out so I bought more coins to freeze the time. On the last second I ordered a timer, which took some of my coins, yet the game did not freeze the timer so the level ended & those coins were basically “stolen”. Oh yeah, the timer freeze feature is useless anyway because it only freeze it for 10 seconds. 

Believe the other reviews, saying the same things. I just found myself being upset by playing it. I just deleted the app. Fun at first but won’t be back! Hopefully another less money hungry developer will make a similar game.

author: Eilla_Doodles
title: Timer too punishing, and potential ai usage.
content:
A wonderful merge of the block puzzle games, and the sand collecting games. I had a lot of fun with it! Until, of course, I reached around level 70. Suddenly, you had to know the exact movements to beat the level in order to do so in time. It made the game a repetitive, frustrating slog. And then they added these new creatures, which I fear to be AI due to the art style and inconsistencies between each rendition of them. Add it with the life system, and it became entirely unplayable and unrelaxing.

It has a few ads, but those are spaced out and not too bad, so they don’t impact my score much positively or negatively.

It’s a fun game, but perhaps quit around level 60 if you don’t want to suffer.

author: Adustplacebo
title: Remove the timer
content: I’d play this game all day but the timer really bothers me, it forces me to spent points I’ve collected to extend the time. I’d like this game to be more relaxing. If it’s loss of revenue, maybe just charge for no time limit. I’d pay for that to have a better experience.

author: Paulina6695
title: Fun, but can’t play long
content: The game is a ton of fun, like super addicting - but the timer mixed with having limited lives makes it impossible to play for long. The levels are just too hard with the timer, and then you run out of lives and are out of luck without watching tons of ads. Then, it’s no longer worth it.

author: Amateurchemist
title: Relax mode?
content:
I really enjoy playing this game. I’m on level 132. So far the ads haven’t been too many or intrusive. Please don’t change that. :)

I’d love to see this with the option to remove the timer. Either to pay to remove the timer from all levels or watch an ad before a puzzle. 

Also would love to be able to replay levels. Especially the harder ones. Then once you have mastered it, you could turn the timer back on to try to beat your best time.

author: 1122Angi
title: Help
content: I am suck on level 124 could anyone help me get through it??

author: Tritchen
title: Forced sharing
content: I wanted to try the game - but you are forced to let them share your information with advertisers. I refuse to do this, so I deleted the game.

author: Najvdnehsb
title: Scam
content: Some levels are not able to pass without spending on them, this game is a scam

author: JMC's Ipad
title: Fun but frustrating and costly to progress
content: The hard levels are impossible without using boosts, sometimes 2 or more of them. Too little time and literally no way to move pieces on the “board” without using a boost item. The boosts cost way too many of the free coins for completing levels. Only way to progress is to spend on expensive packages with few boost items -  Its a shame, fun game but deleting it. Too frustrating

author: AuntPandaOma
title: Decent game but has issues
content: I love the game but agree with others that the timer needs an option to turn it off. Also would like the option to watch ads to earn more time out coins so I can buy the power ups. My biggest complaint is the level I hit is literally impossible to win and there’s no ways to contact support since the game isn’t listed on your site!

author: Aaazzzooonnn
title: I wish I could turn the timer off
content: I really like the game, but the timer makes it way too challenging.    I want to enjoy it without the timer.   I hope you will make it an option.

author: AlteregoVT
title: Impossible level
content:
I genuinely love this game. It makes you think! And I haven’t seen repeating levels and I’m on level 200. However, level 200 is the reason I’m not giving 5 stars. I am stuck on this level and I have been for days. I tried reaching out to support for some hints or tips but have heard nothing from them. It’s hard to keep wanting to play the game when you’re stuck in the same spot for days on end. There’s not a lot of ads but I’ve voluntarily watched them to get extra lives because I really do enjoy the game. But it looks like I’ll have to leave because I really don’t want to keep losing the same level over and over and over again. And with zero response from the devs, that’s not promising either.
Please offer some kind of help. I really don’t want to give it up.

Edit- I finally beat Evelyn 200. Onward and upward! No help from the devs so I’ve learned I’m on my own. I will continue to play until I can’t anymore I guess. It really is a good game. Added one star because I get to keep playing. Would love to give 5 stars but with zero response from the devs, I can’t.

author: AkimboFreak13
title: Level 375
content: It’s a pretty good game, challenging but not too hard. I’m at level 375 and it can’t be passed. There is still green sand left but no more green blocks to get it so you aren’t able to get past this level.

author: Celeca7
title: Super fun
content: I love this game. So relaxing. No ads. I see complaints about the timer, and while i agree it would be nice to have an option to turn the timer off, the time it gives you is plenty to solve the puzzle

author: KT(:
title: Too Challenging
content: I LOVE this game. I’m on level 198 and I’m a bit confused about other reviewers’ experiences of repeating levels, because, at least in these later levels, every level is very different. However, it would be REALLY nice if the only way to get extra time or boosters wasn’t just spending coins. The timer is really rough, and I almost never win a level on the first round, so being able to watch an ad to get extra time or something would be AMAZING.

author: PuzzleGamer2026
title: Sand Blocks
content: Makes me feel smart!

author: chasekittie
title: Disappointed
content: Reached level 93: no option what so ever to do anything.   I’m done

author: hoppylady123
title: Great Game!
content: Love this game! All the bad reviews say there is not enough levels. If the worst thing you can say about a game is “I Want More” it must be a good game.

author: BCinVA
title: Ditch the timer
content: I play these types of games to relax. The timer adds to the stress and defeats the purpose of relaxation

author: Ushsbshsjabbzhxhjx
title: I'm tired
content: Another game with a compelling core gameplay loop that’s ruined by increasingly impossible timers unless you’re willing to sit through ads to extend them. Save yourself the frustration and skip this one with confidence.

author: Jseidel5263
title: Timer ruins game
content: It was fun but the timer ruins it. Needs an option to turn it off. It’s frustrating and not relaxing at all when trying to beat a clock. Could be a great game but it’s not. Get rid of the timer.

author: Videkov
title: Super fun game.
content: I really enjoy the puzzles and try to solve them. My only complaint is that they start repeating.

author: Bubba8017
title: Timed
content: I like the game but the fact that it’s timed is not fun.

author: AdWatcher64
title: Timer stress
content: Fun, but the timer makes the game very UNRELAXING.   Doubly so because there is no way to earn extra time. No watch this 30 second ad for 60 extra seconds of play.  Often, I see how to solve it, but just can’t move the pieces fast enough.  Please remove the timer or at least let us earn extra time by watching ads.

author: Rydaia
title: Fun til around level 48ish
content: Was fun til the levels are literally repeating, but I’ll keep for a few weeks in hopes that it updates. But beat the first 50 levels in an hour of straight play, so there isn’t any more for me to do unless they update with more levels

author: Don't spend money on the game
title: Sand Blocks
content: Was very disappointed in the game after l had reach 79 the levels where repeating it’s over and over again so l had deleted the game you should of had others levels that’s don’t repeat itself so that’s is why l gave it TWO STARS

author: Zimba The CodeMonkey
title: Fun but limited
content: This game is fun, with higher levels becoming challenging.  There are no or very few ads, the timer is generous , no boosters to spend money on, and it’s fun to watch the sand flow.  HOWEVER after about 50 levels, they start repeating, and you see the same levels over and over again.  I’ll keep it around and see if it updates with more levels, but I won’t play it more for now.
